summary: An April 1st joke RFC that purports to establish a Protocol Police, a body to assess and enforce correct protocol behavior. It plays on the IETF saying We are not the Protocol Police. It is humorous and not a real standard or organization.

eli5.summary: A joke document that pretends the Internet's rule-makers have created a police force to hand out tickets to badly behaved computer programs.
